utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. If we could, once again, have P62 and focus on the area of the railway station. That's fine, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Mr. Rajcic, if you could please circle for us the target which you indicated as the railway station in Knin, and place a number 6 next to it.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Talking about this target, and with regard to the photograph I have in front of me, the target is too wide or too deep depending on how you look at it. I need the X, Y, and Z coordinates again. But I will identify the target roughly. You want me to place the number 6 here?

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: And in connection with that, I would ask you whether your designation of the railway station as a target was intended to include just the main railway tracks, or the station itself, or both, or anything else?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The intention was to damage the tracks, to prevent trains from going through.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: If we could have this marked and admitted, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: In the absence of any objections, Mr. Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That's Exhibit P2333, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And is admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Thank you. If we could have the full P62 now.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: The next target you list, Mr. Rajcic, is -- or are bridges in the town of Knin which I take to be more than one bridge. However, I will ask you to circle the bridges to which you refer.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: And if we could have the full photograph of P62. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Are you able, Mr. Rajcic, to identify here for us the bridges to which you refer in your reconstruction?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We would have to zoom in on the southern part, because I recognise the barracks where UNPROFOR was, and it should be thereabouts. Could you focus in on the castle area?

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: If you need it further focussed, Mr. Rajcic, just let us know.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can see one bridge but not the other.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Then if you could simply mark the one bridge.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Number 7, right?

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: I believe that's correct, yes.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: And, Mr. President, I will offer this into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: No objections. Mr. Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That's Exhibit P2334, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: P2334 is admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: And if we could have another fresh version of P62.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: And, Mr. Rajcic, if you could guide us as to where the next bridge you believe is located.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The bridge across the Butiznica river is in the direction of Gracac, where you go from Knin to Otric.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Mr. Registrar, if we could move the photograph all the way to the left and focus the area below where it says "Knin army barracks." Bring that down a bit. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Do you see the bring you are referring to in this photograph, Mr. Rajcic?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Is that where you see indicated Butiznica bridge -- Butiznica river, I'm sorry, is that the river to which you're referring?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It says Butiznica river. We can follow the stream, downstream, and in the area around this mark that says TO Madesevac, it should be there somewhere. That is in the lower right corner.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: I see. So is it beyond the area which is photographed?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Thank you. Now the final target that you indicate are a cross-roads in the town of Knin, and I'll ask you to indicate to us where those cross-roads are and circle those.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That cross-roads should be in Kninsko Polje, in the direction towards Dinara. The cross-roads Strmica-Vrlika.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: If we could move to the top left corner of the photograph, I believe at this magnification. Can you guide us from here, Mr. Rajcic, as to where those cross-roads are?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I can't. There are too many roads and cross-roads in these outskirts of Knin, so I cannot identify it fast.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Are you able to tell us if the cross-roads your referring to is somewhere between the area of the hospital and downtown Knin, or if it's somewhere west or north-west -- or north of the hospital area?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think it should be in the north-east of that area, toward Vrlika. It is outside Knin proper. However I don't know whether from an administrative point of view that is also considered part of the town of Knin.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Mr. Registrar, if we could move the photograph down --I'm sorry, not -- right. If we could put it back where it was. And if you could move it slowly downwards.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: And, Mr. Rajcic, if you could tell me if it is located -- what you consider to be this area of cross-roads, is it anywhere on this photograph or is simply outside the area of this photograph?

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: If we could move it up just a bit more.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This -- or, rather, that cross-roads is not in the area shown.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, the targets that you've identified in that section and that you have circled for us here on these various maps, were those targets which were actually fired upon during Operation Storm?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: And can you tell us whether, in addition to those targets that you've identified, there were any other areas or locations inside the town of Knin proper that were actually fired at on the 4th or 5th of August by Croatian forces?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: They fired at the cross-roads beyond the barracks, the northern camp or Slavko Rodic. Should I mark it or -- whenever I mark, it's done with the caveat that I need the X, Y, and Z coordinates. It could be this cross-roads near the barracks or this one. It's hard for me to say, based on this black and white photograph with all this greenery here. So it is either one or the other.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Thank you. And I would simply ask you to write the letter C, or simply just write the word "cross-roads" on there. If that is possible to do. If you can just write "cross-roads" somewhere between those two.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the KV hospital in the table of targets and not the cross-roads.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: I'm sorry, before you mark anything else, I want to make sure I understand what you're indicating to us. When you say the KV hospital in the table of targets and not the cross-roads, the two circles that you just drew, those were areas where -- or one or the other of those was actually fired at by Croatian forces on the 4th or 5th of August. Am I correct about that?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Russo, I'm not talking about areas, because if we say areas we're speaking about two targets or two instances of firing. I'm --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The interpreters have lost part of the answer. If the witness could be asked to repeat.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Perhaps you put the question again to the witness, Mr. Russo. Perhaps take it one by one. We see two markings, one more to the north-east, which is a larger circle. Perhaps you start with that one.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Mr. Rajcic, the circle that you placed near the cross-roads more to the north-east in this photograph, can you tell us what that was meant to represent, and whether you can say if that area was fired at on the 4th or 5th of August?

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Your question, as far as I remember, and do correct me if I'm wrong, was: Which other targets were fired upon in Knin, apart from the ones marked so far?

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: MARKO RAJCIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: To that question, when you showed me this slide, I replied that we fired on a target in the immediately vicinity of the Slavko Rodic barracks, or the northern camp, but take into consideration the quality of this photograph and the surface area of the town, I need the exact coordinates, X, Y, and Z, to determine the exact location. So, therefore, I cannot say whether the cross-roads in question is this one that is closer to the barracks, or the other in the -- in a north-west direction from that part. And that's why I drew these two circles, conditionally.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Russo, I'm looking at the clock. We have to finish for the day. Usually ask whether it's a suitable moment, but it is the moment.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: If I could simply tender this, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. No objections.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: No objection.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that becomes Exhibit P2336.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: P2336 is admitted into evidence. Could I have an update on your timing, Mr. Russo.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President, I just wanted to tender the reconstruction that we have been going off of as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: Sorry --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: The document prepared.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: Yes. That's -- I believe it was on the 65 ter list.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. No objections. None of the other Defence teams. Mr. Registrar, that would be number? The reconstruction is the -- perhaps you repeat, Mr. --

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: Yes, that's 65 ter 7055.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, that becomes Exhibit P2337.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: P2337 is admitted into evidence. Mr. Russo, and update, and we can't loose much more time.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: I believe I will need least all of tomorrow, Your Honour, and possibly another session or two after that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That's far more than you indicated.

utterances.speaker: MR. RUSSO
utterances.text: I do understand that, Mr. President, and I apologise, and I beg the court's indulgence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: The Chamber will consider the matter, but, first of all, Mr. Kehoe, Mr. Misetic for the Gotovina Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: I'm not certain at that point, Mr. President. Given the 92 ter statement, it could be quite brief.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. You are a champion in giving answers, which I do not give many.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: [Overlapping speakers] ... I wouldn't say that it is much more than, say, 45 minutes at this juncture.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I see that, but brief could be anything between one and ten hours in my experience.

utterances.speaker: MR. KEHOE
utterances.text: I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, but now it is clear it me. Ms. Higgins.

utterances.speaker: MS. HIGGINS
utterances.text: At present, no questions, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Mikulicic.

utterances.speaker: MR. MIKULICIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, as it stands for now, I will have maybe one session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: One session, approximately. That is clear. The Chamber will, as I said, explore whether we could find additional time. Unfortunately, we're unable to continue tomorrow in the afternoon, that's for sure, because of agenda problems. We'll consult with the parties. We ...

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: I'd like to make a correction to the record. I inadvertently skipped an exhibit number. The map marked by the witness should have been Exhibit P2335, which would make 65 ter number 7055 Exhibit P2336.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. And a reference to map marked by the witness might lead to some confusion today. Therefore, it was the last map we've seen with the two small circles marked on this map. We adjourn for the day, but not, Mr. Rajcic, until after I have instructed you, as I did yesterday, not to speak with anyone about your testimony, whether given already, or still to be given, and we'd like to see you back tomorrow morning, 9.00 in this same courtroom, I. We adjourn until then.
